verdict.seen: Camera moves in on the cut floor, then a small white bowl sits on top of a vertical drain pipe that leads into the ground cut.
Brown waste lumps hover in an arc above and beside the bowl, mostly outside it, and do not clearly drop in or pile up inside the bowl.
verdict.problem: The lumps stay in the air beside the bowl; make them fall into the bowl and rest in a pile inside it.

verdict.seen: The first frame shows waste lumps on the bowl. After that a tank with a handle appears and water balls flush through the bowl. Brown waste drops into the drain pipe below.
A large white up arrow sits beside the toilet with blue water balls in the bowl. No green gas is rising out of the bowl.
verdict.problem: Add green gas visibly rising from the bowl, with arrows pointing up along it.

verdict.seen: A glowing yellow rectangle outlines the pipe section below the bowl, which marks the trap. The toilet and drain are in view.
A tall glowing yellow outline traces a vertical vent stack rising through the wall area, with the toilet small at the left.
Up and down translucent arrows surround the toilet in all three frames, with the trap outline visible. The push arrows are clearly in view.
The toilet is in view in the first two frames, with a waste ball moving down the drain. The last frame is a wide view of the whole toilet and pipe running to the tank.
The strip pulls out from the toilet, vent and pipe to a full cutaway of the house, lawn, pipe, tank and ground layers. The final frames show the whole build clearly with nothing covering it.
